entities.title: Godot client scripts
entities.summary: Everything in the client but the rules: the screens, a game beside the 3D table, the table and pieces, the look, the sounds, and the connection to the Worker and the page.
entities.purpose: Main shows one screen at a time over the 3D table; GameScreen shows a game online, against the computer or in replay; Board3D and PieceMeshes are the table; UI and Avatar the look; Sfx the sounds; Api the server's API, the live connection and the page bridge.
boundaries: The rules are godot/chess/; the server decides online games, and the page bridge runs Stockfish.
The desktop build (the editor, the reference renders) talks to a dev server with a Bearer token and has no computer opponent.
